final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as col2 FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(col2) as col1 FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.ordertune as col1, s1.col2 as col2, CAST(s1.col2 AS REAL) / CAST(s2.col1 AS REAL) as col3 FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.col1 IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(col3) as col1 FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.col1, s3.col2, s3.col3, s3.col3 - s4.col1 as col4 FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.col1 IS NOT NULL AND s3.col3 > s4.col1) SELECT SUM(col2) as sum_col2, AVG(col3) as avg_col3, AVG(col4) as avg_col4 FROM step5
